$header_note: QPB v1.5.7 BLIND CVE-benchmark plan — 7 runs pinned to vulnerable-parent SHAs from Security Research/CVE_BENCHMARK_PILOT.md. Each row's `ref` is the commit EXACTLY ONE COMMIT BEFORE the security fix landed (parent = fix^, git-verified). The repos' docs_gathered/ folders have been SCRUBBED of: CVE IDs, GHSA IDs, fix-PR numbers, fix-symbol function names, and 'fix added X' sentences. QPB must derive the bugs from invariants + code alone. Per the pilot's pass_criterion column, each case has a specific 'must flag X' bar to clear. 2026-06-01 build. Methodology: see Security Research/CVE_BENCHMARK_METHODOLOGY.md. Categories covered (Goal A scoreboard breadth test): path traversal (×2 — setuptools + jsPDF), code injection (avro), deserialization (spark), DoS (dasel), crypto misuse (evervault-go), broken access control (gogs). CAVEAT: gogs's docs_gathered focuses on CVE-2026-25229 (UpdateLabel) rather than the CASE-010 target CVE-2025-65852 (DELETE /repos) — the access-control framing is correct but the specific bug is different. Blind run on gogs evaluates QPB's general access-control detection capability rather than the exact CASE-010 fingerprint. Concurrency: pool={claude:3, codex:1} — 6 claude + 1 codex; runtime bounded by claude/opus on Spark.

runs.description: Row 0 — claude/opus reviews apache/spark (Scala/JVM, vulnerable parent for insecure deserialization in History Server) via clone (Mode A). Pass criterion: flag JsonProtocol.sparkEventFromJson's polymorphic class instantiation from event-log JSON without a type-allowlist. opus selected for JVM deserialization-pattern reasoning. See repos/docs_gathered/spark/ (scrubbed).

Row 1 — claude/opus reviews evervault/evervault-go (Go SDK, vulnerable parent for cryptographic verification — lowest QE-catchability per the benchmark). Pass criterion: flag PCR-presence-check missing in attestation verification (empty PCRs accepted, forged/partial attestation passes). opus selected for the toughest crypto/attestation case. See repos/docs_gathered/evervault-go/ (scrubbed).

Row 2 — claude/sonnet reviews pypa/setuptools (Python, vulnerable parent for path traversal in package_index download). Pass criterion: flag _resolve_download_filename / _download_url for unvalidated join allowing escape outside tmpdir. Portfolio's 'CLEANEST' case — sonnet sufficient. See repos/docs_gathered/setuptools/ (scrubbed).

Row 3 — claude/sonnet reviews parallax/jsPDF (JavaScript, vulnerable parent for LFI in Node build). Pass criterion: flag nodeReadFile/loadFile for reading unrestricted caller-supplied path from filesystem. Localized fix (1 file). See repos/docs_gathered/jsPDF/ (scrubbed).

Row 4 — claude/sonnet reviews TomWright/dasel (Go, vulnerable parent for unbounded YAML alias expansion DoS). Pass criterion: flag recursive parse with no depth/size bound on attacker input. New category for QPB Goal A scoreboard (DoS). See repos/docs_gathered/dasel/ (scrubbed).

Row 5 — claude/sonnet reviews gogs/gogs (Go, vulnerable parent for broken access control). Pass criterion (CASE-010): flag DELETE /repos/:username/:reponame for missing repo-owner middleware (read-only collaborator can delete). CAVEAT: docs_gathered focuses on a different access-control CVE (CVE-2026-25229 UpdateLabel) — blind run evaluates general AC detection, not specific CASE-010 fingerprint. See repos/docs_gathered/gogs/ (scrubbed).

Row 6 — codex/gpt-5.4 reviews apache/avro (Java codegen, vulnerable parent for code injection in SpecificCompiler) via clone (Mode B). Pass criterion: flag schema-property → generated-source unvalidated taint flow. Codex Mode B for ecosystem variety on JVM. See repos/docs_gathered/avro/ (scrubbed).
